import awkward as ak
from pocket_coffea.workflows.base import BaseProcessor
from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_functions import get_cut_position


class DimuonProcessor(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis processor using PocketCoffea 0.9.13"""

    def process_objects(self, events, year, sample, **kwargs):
        """Override object preselection to build MuonGood collection"""
        # Get muons from events
        muons = events.Muon
        
        # Apply pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4 cuts
        muon_good = muons[
            (muons.pt > 15) & 
            (ak.abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)
        ]
        
        # Store MuonGood collection in events
        events["MuonGood"] = muon_good
        
        return events

    def process_after_preselection(self, events, year, sample, **kwargs):
        """Override object counting hook to store number of selected muons"""
        # Count MuonGood muons per event
        muon_counts = ak.num(events.MuonGood)
        
        # Store as new branch in events
        events["n_muons_good"] = muon_counts
        
        return events
